module.purpose: Defines the Next.js application root layout, including request-derived locale and embed settings, global metadata, fonts, translation loading, providers, and shared document structure.
module.summary: This server-rendered layout establishes the application's HTML and body shell for every route. It configures fonts, viewport and SEO metadata, derives localization and embedding state from request headers and cookies, loads common translations, and composes icon sprites, speculation rules, providers, and the application router internationalization provider around child content.
module.businessContext: Supports Cal.com’s localized scheduling application and embedded booking experiences. Failure affects page rendering, language direction, branding, metadata, translations, and iframe visibility.
functions: getInitialProps (~L79-92): Derives locale, text direction, and embedding settings from request context
RootLayout (~L94-159): Renders the localized application document shell and shared providers

io: Reads request headers and cookies through Next.js request APIs.
Loads the common translation namespace for the resolved locale.

edgeCases.behavior: The embedding flag is false and the body remains visible.
The html element receives no colorScheme style.
English is selected as the fallback locale.
The head nonce defaults to an empty string.
The body uses a transparent background and hidden visibility.

boundaryConditions.intent: Recognizes embedding only when the request header exactly equals the string true.

invariants.description: Locale resolution falls back to English when getLocale returns a nullish value.
The common translation namespace is loaded using the resolved locale.
The rendered document always supplies locale and direction attributes.
Translations are loaded before the internationalization provider renders children.

assumptions.description: Next.js invokes the layout with a React children value and request-bound server APIs.
The locale resolver returns a locale string compatible with i18next direction and translation loading.
Upstream middleware may provide x-isEmbed, x-embedColorScheme, and x-csp headers.

ambiguities.question: Does loadTranslations read only local resources or contact an external translation backend?

concurrencyModel.notes: Each layout invocation independently awaits request context, locale resolution, and translation loading.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When locale resolution returns no locale, the layout uses English.
When a locale is resolved, the document direction is derived from that locale.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures localized documents use the correct text direction.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the request is an embed, the body is transparent and initially hidden.
moduleContractTests.then: rendered body style contains { background: "transparent", visibility: "hidden" }
moduleContractTests.rationale: Protects embed initialization behavior before parent styling is applied.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the request is not an embed, the body remains visible.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Prevents normal pages from inheriting embed-only hidden state.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The resolved locale translations are passed to the application i18n provider.
moduleContractTests.then: rendered AppRouterI18nProvider receives translations, locale, and ns
